notes.caps: production 1.4.1 tip caps are the cell polygon scaled by 0.0700 (min 0.0700, max 0.0700 over 1137 parts) -- NOT the tip_caps.py triangle (export 1.4 used triangles); cap vertex count = cell vertex count; the cap centroid sits at centroid + lean_length * lean, z = height
notes.cell_scales: cell_scales[idx] = shrink of Voronoi cell idx about its centroid; it is an exact linear function of the field magnitude at the seed: scale = 0.80520 + 51.531 * |B| = 0.80520 + 0.14840 * (|B| / |B|max), |B| from unit antiparallel currents at CoreRadius 243.84 mm (|residual| max 2.5e-05 over 1200 cells); stored per part anyway
notes.cells: true cell polygon = DXF OUTLINES ghost un-scaled by 1/0.75 about the ghost polygon centroid, shifted by -25.4 mm (physical -> model datum), CCW, production vertex order, repeated closing vertex dropped; DXF coordinates carry 3 decimals, so cell vertices are exact to ~0.0007 mm; every 1.4.1 plate mesh base matches its cell within 0.0018 mm
notes.centroid: polygon centroid of the cell (= the production centroid pin within 0.0011 mm for every part with pins)
notes.coil_board_points: the 12 production coil ring holes (PINHOLES), model mm, left ring first then right ring, each ordered by angle from +X
notes.exported: true for the 1137 rows of manifest 1.4.1; false for the 58 coil-captured parts and the 5 parts dropped in 1.4.1 (F109, F111, G101, G122, G83)
notes.field: 2D Biot-Savart evaluated at the seeds: with the contract core radius 0.1 mm the direction misses the production lean by median 2.275 deg, max 147.904 deg (pinned parts: median 2.211, max 14.528); with CoreRadius 0.1 x 96 in = 243.84 mm (fit 243.84) by median 0.0011, max 0.0047 deg (pinned parts: median 0.0011, max 0.0047) -- the production solve used CoreRadius 243.84 mm and evaluated the field at the Voronoi seeds (see notes.field_at_seeds once recover_seeds.py has run)
notes.field_at_seeds: the production field was evaluated AT THE SEEDS with CoreRadius 243.84 mm (0.1 x 96 in): 2D Biot-Savart at the recovered seeds reproduces the production lean of all 1142 pinned parts to median 0.0011 deg, max 0.0047 deg (pin-rounding noise); at the cell centroids the same solve is off by median 0.100, max 1.314 deg; at core 0.1 mm by median 2.21, max 14.53 deg
notes.height: zmax - zmin of the production mesh (4 decimals) for every exported/dropped part (manifests carry the same value rounded to 0.1 mm); coil-captured parts: world zmax of the coil 3MF mesh (bases at z = 0) when the cap survived, else estimated from the fitted H(|B|) law (20 parts, listed in the report)
notes.idx: DXF OUTLINES order = production pipeline index; verified by recomputing labels.py's banded-reading-order IDs from the centroids (1200/1200 match the manifests) and by the coil idx set being exactly the pin-less outlines
notes.lean: unit(lean pin - centroid pin) from the DXF PINHOLES for the 1142 parts with pins; coil-captured parts: the cap-centroid minus base-centroid direction of the coil 3MF mesh (translation-only frame) when the cap survived the trim (37 parts), else the ported field at the fitted core radius (21 parts, listed in the report)
notes.lean_length: XY distance from the base polygon centroid to the 7%-scaled-cell cap centroid of the production mesh (1.4.1 plate meshes for the 1137 exported parts; coil 3MFs for captured parts with a surviving cap); the 5 dropped parts (1.4 triangle caps) and the trimmed coil parts take the poly5 L(height) law (26 parts, listed in the report)
notes.lean_length_law: lean_length IS a smooth deterministic function of height but not a linear one: linear lean_length = 1.326619 * height + -32.315557 (|residual| max 7.076 mm, median 0.942 mm), quadratic |residual| max 3.890 mm; a degree-5 polynomial in u = (height - 97.786401) / 62.313599 reproduces it to |residual| max 0.0122 mm, median 0.0004 mm over 1137 exported parts (height 35.47..160.10 mm); lean/height runs 0.615..1.124; coefficients (low to high in u): 96.301463, 86.082844, 3.922008, -7.063055, 0.692378, 0.064730; coil-part measurements land on the same curve within 0.0037 mm; closed form not identified (see golden/production/extraction_report.json for the binned table)
notes.plate_yaw: the production plates are NOT yawed so the lean points +Y (|yaw - lean yaw| median 0.574, max 6.882 deg); they are yawed so that (seed - centroid) + lean_length * lean points +Y: plate_packer.py's Apexes were seed-based apex points while its Centroids were the cell centroids (verified against all 1137 plate meshes: |yaw - predicted| median 0.0012, max 0.0050 deg)
notes.seeds: recovered by corpus/tools/recover_seeds.py: the Voronoi of `seeds` bounded by `workable` (kept = the first 1200 in idx order, then 0 recovered culled neighbours; keep[] says which), each kept cell SHRUNK about its own area centroid by cell_scales[idx], reproduces every production cell vertex within 0.0020 mm (max 0.0011, median 0.0004); the 1200 kept cells tile the workable rectangle completely (no culled cells); kept seeds sit 1.73 mm (median, max 6.03) from the cell centroids
notes.wires: cylinder centre = mean of its 6 coil ring holes (PINHOLES), radius = 2 x ring radius (pin_holes.py CoilPinRadiusFrac 0.5); current signs chosen so the 2D Biot-Savart direction best matches the production lean: left+1_right-1
